coverImageAlt: Two carved masks on a circular stage connect to branching scenario forms and an orange destination light.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Roleplay-based learning represented by a rotating rehearsal platform where two complementary carved masks face a sequence of branching scenario props and a return path for coaching.
Scene/backdrop: A sparse slate theater-in-the-round on a warm paper field.
Subject: Two featureless sculpted masks, a small circular stage, three abstract choice objects, and a cyan loop returning to an orange mentor light.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe central stage and masks; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: thoughtful, participatory, quietly dramatic
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no written symbols on masks or props; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
